items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because he used to play with Sam in Boston. So he brought Sam in. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Have you heard Sam’s big band?

ctx.x: Because he used to play with Sam in Boston. So he brought Sam in. But I think Sam was too progressive for Miles. Sam had some other stuff.
